record.oneLiner: A sail-backed iguanodontian of Cretaceous Africa.
record.description: Ouranosaurus was a basal hadrosauriform ornithopod herbivore of Early Cretaceous Niger and Cameroon, 7–8.3 m long. It bore tall spines along its back that may have supported a sail or a fatty hump.

notableFacts.text: Bore tall back spines that may have supported a sail or a hump.
An early relative of the duck-billed hadrosaurs.
